column2: Is the problem linked to documented health-system priorities and realistic alternatives?
Are required data lawful, available, timely, representative, traceable, and sustainable?
Can inputs and outputs be exchanged and interpreted consistently within the decision window?
Are identity, access, compute, storage, interfaces, logging, fallback, and recovery adequate?
Can users interpret the output and take the intended action without shifting unsafe burden?
Are roles, training, competency, supervision, and professional responsibilities defined?
Are controls, indicators, evidence, incident processes, and improvement responsibilities integrated?
Are lifecycle costs, resource constraints, benefits, uncertainty, and budget exposure understood?
Are decision rights, safeguards, independent review, monitoring, and authority to stop defined?
Can evidence, audit, updates, data rights, support, pricing, portability, and exit be contracted?
Are resource demand, asset life, maintenance, take-back, residual value, and disposition considered where material?
